rule-1: Eligibility & Registration: This event is open to all EasiCoin users. Users must click "Sign Up Now" on the event page before completing any tasks. Only tasks completed after registration will count toward the points total.
rule-10: EasiCoin reserves the right of final interpretation for the terms and rules of this event. If you have any questions, please contact EasiCoin Official Customer Service.
rule-2: Earning & Redeeming Points: After registering, users will automatically earn points by completing designated daily tasks. Points can be accumulated and used throughout the event. Each reward may only be redeemed once, and the corresponding points will be deducted immediately upon successful redemption.
rule-3: Bonus and Fee Deduction Rewards:Rewards will be automatically credited to your account within 24 hours of successful redemption. To redeem Trial Funds, your futures account must have an available balance ≥ the Trial Funds amount.
rule-4: Task Reset Time: All event tasks are automatically reset daily at 00:00:00 (UTC+0). Only task progress is reset. Users' accumulated points remain unaffected.
rule-5: Physical Reward Delivery: Winners must submit their shipping address before the event ends. Rewards will be shipped within 7 business days after the event concludes. Delivery is limited to Mainland China (excluding Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan, and all overseas regions). Rewards cannot be redeemed for cash.
rule-6: Points Expiration Policy: After the event ends, all unused points will expire. Points cannot be restored, reissued, or transferred between events. Please redeem your points promptly.
rule-7: Violations & Final Interpretation: The following activities are strictly prohibited: wash trading, volume manipulation, self-trading, multi-account abuse, and any other fraudulent activities. Once a violation is verified, the platform reserves the right to revoke reward eligibility and reclaim any rewards already issued. EasiCoin reserves the right to the final interpretation of these rules. If you have any questions, please contact our official customer support
rule-8: After the event ends, all unredeemed points will be cleared automatically and cannot be recovered or reissued.
rule-9: Fraudulent activities, including wash trading, volume manipulation, matched orders, and multi-accounting, are strictly prohibited. EasiCoin reserves the right to disqualify participants and withhold rewards upon discovery.
